description: 生命周期 Chip 定义。Chip 本身不直接调 skill;用户发送注入的预设 prompt 后调起。PRD §4.3.3。

chips.label: Prepare launch pack
chips.preset_prompt: /social-marketing-skills Help me prepare a launch-week social media pack for my app on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube — captions, hashtags, video scripts, and a week-1 posting schedule.

chips.label: Launch week content
chips.preset_prompt: /social-marketing-skills My app is launching now. Generate a week-1 social launch pack for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube with captions, storyboards, and posting schedule.

chips.label: Cold-start content
chips.preset_prompt: /social-marketing-skills My app launched but has no users yet. Help me create a cold-start social content pack for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube to get my first users.

chips.label: 首周推广包
chips.preset_prompt: /social-marketing-skills 帮我为我的应用生成 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 三平台首周社媒推广内容包,包括文案、标签、视频脚本和发布节奏。

chips.label: 冷启动内容
chips.preset_prompt: /social-marketing-skills 我的应用已经上线但没人用,帮我做 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 的冷启动社媒内容包。
